source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Front Suspension, p.3-1

procedures.title: Front suspension: general description
notes: All 1968 Chevrolet lines, Corvette included, use a short-long arm (S.L.A.) independent front suspension with coil springs sitting on the lower control arms.
Spherical (ball) joints link both control arms to the steering knuckle; wheel bearings are tapered roller type.
Corvette camber and caster are both set with shims between the upper control arm inner support shaft and its frame bracket (Chevrolet full-size uses a cam and strut rod instead).
Every Corvette has a front stabilizer bar.
